chapters.title: FORMING
chapters.text: The cash open starts a fresh session VWAP at 25,933.75. It raises no state and no event for its first 15 bars while the anchor forms.

chapters.title: EXTENDED
chapters.text: A second close beyond the session's 90% edge (25,869.50) confirms it: 25,862.75 is -68.25 from the session VWAP, 2.2σ. The RETURN chip reads 77% over 60 bars · HOT.

chapters.title: BACK IN VALUE
chapters.text: The close 25,818.25 came back inside the session's 50% core (25,805.50), which ends the extension below. The session VWAP stands at 25,880.25.

chapters.title: AT VWAP
chapters.text: The first bar since the extension below to trade at the session VWAP 25,873.00 (high 25,877.75). The tool rings it on the SESSION strip and clears the extension.
